notes.title: Small update v1.1.3
notes.content:
I’ve made a small update to Stratos which should address some issues users have experienced. I’m working towards a Story Mode for v1.2.0, so this update contains a few pre-requisite features, such as Captaincy.

[h2]Captain[/h2]
[list]
[*] A member is designated a captain at the start of the game.
[*] Captaincy will pass to another if they perish in combat.
[*] Cosmetic actions – talking to islanders and using ship wheel.
[*] Crew quarters & captain’s desk prop
[/list]
[h2]Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Remove floating arrows
[*] Disabled UE4 VR plugin
[*] Clarified some text
[*] If a prop (chair, beds, etc…) is occupied, fire doesn’t destroy it
[*] Corrected gear when selecting “Old Soldier” background 
[*] Stop battle music if fleeing combat
[/list]
[h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased Mineral node spawn chance
[*] ‘Crafting resource’ trader now in marketplace
[/list]

notes.title: Stratos Version 1.1 Launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35808451/35fc37d3d93d460b0e87d8914e5067d2fdaa110d.png[/img]

Hey all,
I’m happy to announce Stratos has just been updated to version 1.1!
Main features include the introduction of special abilities, found on weapons & armour.
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attach and defence of enemy units now scale with player level
[*] Enemy fortifications- can only be destroyed by cannons
[*] Obstacles – take up unit space in the arena
[*] Corrected Bow & Arrow animations
[/list]
[h2]Quests[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapons and armour are now quest rewards
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some room descriptions missing
[*] Crafting menu is better organized for navigation
[*] Inventory menu is now a list, showing names of items & stats
[*] Audio
[*] Included some missing sounds for combat FX
[*] Separate controls for Music, Master & SFX volume
[/list]
[h2]Gear[/h2]
[list]
[*] More weapons and armour
[*] Unlock new crafting recipes each player level up to 19
[*] Wands that feature strong magical abilities
[*] Charms that improve passive stats in combats
[/list]
[h2]Ship[/h2]
[list]
[*] Training Rooms – An Entertainment room that improves strength of crew members that visit it
[*] Crew
[*] Crew no longer level up by combat XP. Each Stat is improved by conducting various tasks or being equipped with certain weapons in combat.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.1 Live
notes.content:
Hey all,

Good news - I’ve just put version 0.8.1 live! 

[h1]Stats[/h1]
[h2]Hygiene[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mess has been replaced with a ship-wide and room-based Hygiene stat.
[*] Rooms will get progressively messier each hour, with dust, mess then mice appearing if uncleaned.
[*] Labourers will clean them automatically if the Hygiene value drops too low.
[*] Poor Hygiene will reduce Happiness and increase the chance a crew member will become sick.
[*] Crew members with lower Resistance will be the first to become sick.
[/list]
[h2]Happiness[/h2]
[list]
[*] Happiness is now a ship-wide stat, updated on the hour.
[*] Sources of Happiness & Unhappiness include Hunger, Thirst, Wages & Hygiene
[*] Unhappy crew may leave the ship
[*] Crew lower higher Fortitude will be the last to leave if too unhappy
[*] Visiting a new island will boost happiness on that hour
[/list]

[h1]New Rooms[/h1]
[h2]Washrooms[/h2]
[list]
[*] Washrooms will provide a bonus to Hygiene stat, helping prevent crew from getting sick
[/list]
[h2]Navigation Deck[/h2]
[list]
[*] These external rooms provide Navigation power, which is required to search for special islands
[/list]
[h2]Library[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adds to Happiness
[/list]

[h1]World[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved the Sun & Moon to be onscreen while in the normal mode
[/list]

notes.title: New Ship Building mechanics
notes.content:
Hey all,

After a radical overhaul of gameplay mechanics, I’m happier with the direction the project is going and just pushed the latest version on to Steam.

[list]
[*] The main game mode now features a 2.5D camera
[*] Ships now consist of sections and rooms
[*] Sections extend your ship length wise
[*] Rooms can be built and stacked
[*] Crew members can be assigned to rooms to provide functionality
[/list]

With this change, categories in the Workshop will no longer be compatible, and essentially disabled – sorry to anyone this annoyed.

Many features are still missing- ones that would make it a game rather than a sandbox. If you’d like to check out the full-game through the demo, then I’d love to hear your feedback here or on Discord @ https://discord.gg/qZ6aHn9

Thanks everyone and cheers for your patience!

notes.title: Azure v0.6.0 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35808451/f9c0dfd03a586ccb885dbb101d58a2fa8ceb47a8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35808451/13bb4d29dc578af3d6c1fb4ce30958882896c05c.png[/img]

Hey all,

Version 0.6.1 update is live now! This and all 0.6x versions focus on combat.
The combat system is now based on an Auto-Chess style- the player will setup units at the start of combat round, then provide support abilities during the match as the heroes battle it out.

[list]
[*] Crew members become injured if they fall in combat, and will perish entirely if they fall again.
[*] Two arenas have been included to start with – Nature & Stone.
[*] Inhabitants of islands have their own gear sets, e.g. Metal, cloth
[*] Orc mobs may spawn on resource islands and prevent the player for harvesting nodes until they are defeated.
[*] 
[/list]

I’m always looking for your advice and feedback, please feel free to comment with your thoughts!

notes.title: Azure Update 0.4.7 now Live!
notes.content:
Hey all,

I’m happy to announce Azure version 0.4.7 is now live.

This update focuses on Steam Workshop integration- you can now design your own ships and material palettes and share them with others. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1890884431 

Unfortunately Steam doesn’t support access to the Workshop via the demo, so I’ll be looking for different sites to host the mods.

This update also includes some various bug-fixes and the start of a Codex to help inform the player of different features.

notes.title: Azure V0.4.4 Now Live
notes.content:
Hey all,
Azure version 0.4.4 is now live on Steam! This update focuses on extending the features of ship-based and world NPCs.

[h1]World[/h1]
[list]
[*] All NPCs in the world have a unique name.
[*] More interactive NPCs have been created, including different seller types.
[*] “Heralds” are now used to recruit citizens. An option is given to the player of potential recruits.
[/list]

[h1]Citizens[/h1]
[list]
[*] NPCs now have fixed and variable stats; such as Wellbeing, Stamina & Happiness.
[*] If citizens are too unwell, unhappy or hungry, they will plan to leave; with an option to pay gold to have them remain.
[/list]

[h1]GUI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Can now change NPC outfit by clicking on them.
[/list]

[h1]Routines[/h1]
[list]
[*] Citizens now follow a fixed routine each day.
[*] Multiple stages include: Work, Work Role, Sleep, Meal and Relax.
[*] “Work Role” forces certain citizens to perform relevant tasks, e.g. a chef will cook for the stage.
[/list]

[h1]Meals[/h1]
[list]
[*] Citizens now seek food 3 times a day
[*] Chefs will prepare a meal for each citizen in advance, if resources are available.
[*] A full meal includes any 1 raw piece of food + a drink. 
[*] Without a full or partial meal, happiness will drop.
[/list]

[h1]Entertainment[/h1]
[list]
[*] Happiness is affected by access to entertainment props, such as Game boards, archery and books.
[/list]
